description:
The Pleezer is our take on the iconic Breezer Series #1 silhouette, and was developed for the MADE 2026 bike show. The one pictured was created for Wilde Co-Owner Andy, who wanted modern componentry with classic aesthetics. The Pleezer is fillet brazed, with boost spacing, disc brakes, and Andy's is set up specifically for an AXS wireless drivetrain (though yours can be tailored to your individual desires). It also features a 1” threaded headset, with Wilde made stub and fillet brazed bullmoose bars. The design intent was to create an everyday around town bike.

Development Story -

Earlier this Spring Andy went to a dealer event at Ibis where he fell in love with Scot Nicol’s Breezer Series II. He came back wanting to own one and went on the hunt for an early Breezer he could buy. Of course his search turned up empty handed as the people who have those things tend to hold onto them. So then that idea morphed into doing a replica, and if you’re going to do a Breezer replica, you go series #1 with its legendary silhouette. We realized very quickly that Breezer replica’s have been done to death and wouldn’t be all that interesting, so the idea morphed from a tribute to an “inspired by” version. We’d make it modern in all the right places while keeping the classic aesthetics intact. It’s got thru axles, disc brakes, 29 inch wheels, and a wireless drivetrain. Its inspiration is clear, but it’s not a replica, not a tribute. It’s something that we think looks fresh, with proportions that just look right with the bigger wheels.

*If you want one, no two will be exactly alike, we will tailor your Pleezer to your hopes, dreams, aspirations, and physical dimensions. A frame, fork, & bullmoose shall be $5800 with a custom paint job or nickel plating included

Standard Features

1" Threaded steerer tube

29 x 2.4" tire clearance

Boost Spacing 148mm rear, 110mm front spacing

Two bottles in main triangle

COMPLETE BIKE BUILD SPEC

We're happy to sell you a frameset or a complete bike. Let's build you the Pleezer of your dreams. Contact us to get started.

DELIVERY

Expect it to take 6 months for us to build you one and get it back from paint or plating
